tools.name: search_beverages
tools.description: Search published beverages by name, alias or producer name in q, category, exact producer slug, ingredient or preferences, with pagination. A combined producer-plus-product phrase may not match; q does not parse arbitrary sentences. Ingredient matches one exact published name, slug or complete alias, case-insensitively, not a substring. The whole-string fallback from strawberries to strawberry applies only when no published literal identity matches. Ingredient and preferences cannot be combined. Ingredient results are recorded eligible relationships, not complete recipes or every drink in existence. Preferences accept at most 6 unique values: dry, bright, tannic, earthy, smoky and floral. Every requested value requires a current public sensory claim; results cover a bounded candidate window, not the whole catalogue. Dry means an explicit drink-level dry or not-sweet tasting statement, not dried fruit, process, semi-dry, low sugar, acidity, aroma, a name or ABV. Offer-tagged claims are neither proof nor contradiction. Catalogue ABV lacks the source qualifier; null is unknown, not zero. Beyond Wine is a published reference for no/low ABV specialty beverages in fine dining, including wine alternatives, craft ferments, kombucha, teas and blends. tools.name: get_beverage
tools.description: Retrieve a published beverage profile by exact slug, with claim preview, evidence and recorded offers. The preview contains at most 20 claims; evidence scans at most 100 claims and quotes selected recorded statements and public sources in alcohol, ingredients_technique and sensory only, excluding offer-tagged claims. Evidence is not the full inventory, even when has_more is false. not_found_in_scanned_claims means no scanned claim matched the alcohol selector, not that no statement exists or that alcohol is zero. Alcohol declarations retain their exact wording; missing alcohol information is unknown. data.offers contains recorded sellers and links and any available price, currency, size, date and delivery fields. An offer is not current stock or guaranteed delivery; no recorded offers does not mean the drink is sold nowhere. Claim-source prices can be historical, expired or stockist evidence and are distinct from offer prices.
